settings.advisorToolsEnabled.desc: Allow the model to call the Advisor tools; /advisor-off disables them across sessions.
settings.advisorToolsEnabled.label: Advisor tools
settings.agentsMdContext.desc: Include trusted project and global AGENTS.md rules in Advisor calls.
settings.agentsMdContext.label: AGENTS.md context
settings.alwaysOn.desc: Run the Advisor flow automatically for supported agent turns.
settings.alwaysOn.label: Always on
settings.autoLoopGate.desc: Ask the Advisor to review repeated equivalent attempts.
settings.autoLoopGate.label: Automatic loop gate
settings.blockOnBlocked.desc: Block the agent when the Advisor returns a critical decision.
settings.blockOnBlocked.label: Block on critical advice
settings.collapseResponses.desc: Collapse long Advisor responses in the transcript.
settings.collapseResponses.label: Collapse long responses
settings.completionGate.desc: Ask the Advisor to review work before declaring success.
settings.completionGate.label: Completion gate
settings.context.label: Context window
settings.customRule.desc: Add a rule that triggers Advisor involvement.
settings.customRule.label: Custom invocation
settings.disableSameModel.desc: Skip advice when the active Executor and Advisor use the same provider/model; turn off to allow higher-effort same-model reviews.
settings.disableSameModel.label: Disable same-model Advisor
settings.effort.desc: Reasoning level used for Advisor calls.
settings.effort.label: Advisor reasoning
settings.failureGate.desc: Ask the Advisor to review repeated failures.
settings.failureGate.label: Failure gate
settings.failureMode.desc: Choose what happens when an Advisor gate fails.
settings.failureMode.label: Gate failure mode
settings.fallbackModel.desc: Retry a failed Advisor request once with this optional model; the primary model remains unchanged.
settings.fallbackModel.label: Fallback Advisor model
settings.gitContext.desc: How much repository context is shared with the Advisor.
settings.gitContext.label: Repository context
settings.gitContextMaxChars.label: Repository context chars
settings.herdrIntegration.desc: Send Advisor activity to the optional Herdr integration.
settings.herdrIntegration.label: Herdr integration
settings.jevDigestMaxChars.desc: Conversation characters sent to Jev as screening evidence.
settings.jevDigestMaxChars.label: Jev digest chars
settings.jevFilter.desc: Screen low-stakes ask_advisor consultations with the selected Jev provider.
settings.jevFilter.label: Jev/Decisions consultation filter
settings.jevFilterNoulMargin.desc: Extra margin over a coin flip required on self-answerability before skipping.
settings.jevFilterNoulMargin.label: Jev Noul margin
settings.jevFilterOverrideWindow.desc: Turns after a skip during which the same question passes automatically.
settings.jevFilterOverrideWindow.label: Jev override window
settings.jevFilterSkipConfidence.desc: Required probability on negligible stakes before a consultation is skipped.
settings.jevFilterSkipConfidence.label: Jev skip confidence
settings.jevProvider.desc: Select a Pi-authenticated classifier or explicitly configure the separate Jev API Key option.
settings.jevProvider.label: Jev classifier
settings.jevTimeoutMs.desc: Total wall-time budget for one Jev call, including retries.
settings.jevTimeoutMs.label: Jev timeout ms
settings.jevTurnGateEveryTurns.desc: Proactively consult the Advisor every N turns without a consultation (0 = off).
settings.jevTurnGateEveryTurns.label: Jev/Decisions turn gate
settings.jevTurnGateNoulThreshold.desc: Jev confidence required before the turn gate interrupts with advice.
settings.jevTurnGateNoulThreshold.label: Jev/Decisions turn-gate threshold
settings.logFeedback.desc: Include budget and Scout status messages in session logs. Actual Advisor calls and results remain visible either way.
settings.logFeedback.label: Advisor log feedback
settings.loopThreshold.desc: Number of equivalent attempts before automatic review.
settings.loopThreshold.label: Loop threshold
settings.maxCallsPerSession.desc: Limit automatic Advisor calls in one session.
settings.maxCallsPerSession.label: Max Advisor calls/session
settings.modelWhitelist.desc: Only the exact provider/model references listed here may call the Advisor; an empty list allows every model.
settings.modelWhitelist.label: Advisor model whitelist
settings.outcomeLogging.desc: Allow anonymized Advisor outcomes to be logged globally.
settings.outcomeLogging.label: Outcome logging (global)
settings.planGate.desc: Ask the Advisor to review implementation plans.
settings.planGate.label: Plan gate
settings.redactSecrets.desc: Redact common credential patterns before Advisor calls.
settings.redactSecrets.label: Redact common secrets
settings.scoutEnabled.desc: Enable the experimental Scout before Advisor calls.
settings.scoutEnabled.label: Experimental Advisor Scout
settings.scoutTimeoutMs.desc: Maximum time for Scout's response stream; model and auth resolution happen before this timeout starts.
settings.scoutTimeoutMs.label: Scout timeout ms
settings.sessionSummary.desc: Show a local summary when the session ends.
settings.sessionSummary.label: Session Advisor Summary
settings.showUsageDetails.desc: Show token usage and cost details in Advisor responses.
settings.showUsageDetails.label: Show usage and cost details
settings.showUsageFooter.desc: Show the current Advisor usage summary in the footer.
settings.showUsageFooter.label: Show usage in footer
settings.simpleMode.desc: Keep enabled Advisor tools available on demand without automatic gates or blocks.
settings.simpleMode.label: Simple mode
settings.toolPolicies.desc: Choose which tools are shared in full, summarized, or excluded.
settings.toolPolicies.invalidPolicies: Use non-empty tool names with full, summary, or exclude values.
settings.toolPolicies.label: Tool disclosure policies
settings.toolPolicies.submenuDesc: Enter a JSON object with "full", "summary", or "exclude" values.
settings.toolResultMaxBytes.desc: Maximum bytes included from a tool result.
settings.toolResultMaxBytes.label: Tool result bytes
settings.toolResultMaxLines.desc: Maximum lines included from a tool result.
settings.toolResultMaxLines.label: Tool result lines
settings.trackedFileContent.desc: Allow tracked file contents to be sent with Advisor context.
settings.trackedFileContent.label: Tracked file content
settings.untrackedContent.desc: Allow untracked file contents to be sent with Advisor context.
settings.untrackedContent.label: Untracked file content
